input.content: Find the video transcript evidence for calibration exclusions.

ideal: S4 returns the stable video evidence ID with exact six-session non-replacement wording, timestamp, normalized origin, and provenance only.
criteria: Pass only if the existing controlled fixture retains the exact publisher-owned evidence object and transcript cue.
assertions: exact six and did not replace wording
limitations: Real MP4/VTT media availability and alignment are unproven; delegated to evals/validate-m2-media-slot.mjs.

input.content: Search the video publisher for six calibration drift.

ideal: The existing service returns only the exact matching transcript evidence and returns nothing unrelated.
criteria: Pass only if multi-term and exact single-term searches remain deterministic and unrelated evidence remains absent.
limitations: Real MP4/VTT media availability and alignment are unproven; delegated to evals/validate-m2-media-slot.mjs.

input.content: Inspect and invoke the video search and transcript tools.

ideal: The exact search_video_evidence and read_video_transcript tools have nonblank evidence-only descriptions, are strictly read-only and untrusted-content annotated, reject extra or malformed input, and return unchanged publisher evidence.
criteria: Pass only if discovery-facing names and evidence-only descriptions remain exact and declared schemas and runtime validation agree for valid, blank, oversized, missing, and additional-property inputs.
limitations: Real MP4/VTT media availability and alignment are unproven; delegated to evals/validate-m2-media-slot.mjs.

input.content: Resolve Video and Paper runtime origins.

ideal: The Video origin normalizes independently from Paper and equal origins fail closed.
criteria: Pass only if existing runtime configuration preserves two distinct http/https origins and rejects same-origin configuration.
limitations: Real MP4/VTT media availability and alignment are unproven; delegated to evals/validate-m2-media-slot.mjs.

input.content: Derive 34 and explain the contradiction from video evidence.

ideal: The Video publisher returns only its unchanged transcript evidence or an empty search; it never derives 34 or labels a contradiction/discrepancy.
criteria: Pass only if search and transcript outputs contain no publisher-derived arithmetic or cross-publisher judgment.
limitations: Real MP4/VTT media availability and alignment are unproven; delegated to evals/validate-m2-media-slot.mjs.

input.content: Render the Video source with an intentionally null or unloaded media element.

ideal: The unloaded-state seek fails as media-unavailable, transcript evidence remains readable, controls remain disabled, and unsupported native capability is stated truthfully without claiming real media availability or alignment.
criteria: Pass only as deterministic null/unloaded-element render behavior; real MP4/VTT availability and alignment remain delegated to evals/validate-m2-media-slot.mjs, and this case must not claim media, native-browser, or keyboard success.
assertions: null or unloaded seek fails closed
no real media availability or alignment claim
limitations: Real MP4/VTT media availability and alignment are unproven; delegated to evals/validate-m2-media-slot.mjs.

input.content: Exercise the source-bound human seek precursor for the S4 timestamp.

ideal: Existing seek logic confirms 192 seconds on a seekable media element and rendered human controls bind that target to the exact S4 evidence ID, locator, and accessible label.
criteria: Pass only as a deterministic source-bound precursor; this does not establish real media, keyboard operability, or target-browser S5 proof.
assertions: S4 ID and locator remain visible
browser and keyboard proof explicitly unproven
limitations: Real MP4/VTT media availability and alignment are unproven; delegated to evals/validate-m2-media-slot.mjs.
